article.headline: Jake West scores 23 to propel Northwestern to 78-65 victory over Stony Brook
article.description: — Jake West scored 23 points and Northwestern never trailed in a 78-65 victory over Stony Brook on Friday night.
article.linkText: Jake West scores 23 to propel Northwestern to 78-65 victory over Stony Brook

article.story: EVANSTON, Ill. -- — Jake West scored 23 points and Northwestern never trailed in a 78-65 victory over Stony Brook on Friday night. West made 8 of 16 shots with four 3-pointers for the Wildcats (2-0), adding six assists. LA Pratt totaled 16 points and six rebounds for Northwestern, while Phoenix Gill came off the bench to hit four 3-pointers and score 14. Bryan Ndjonga had 19 points to lead the Seawolves (1-1). Ozgur Cengiz added 13 points and Morris Ugusuk scored 12. Colin Smith buried a 3-pointer to put the Wildcats up 15-2 less than four minutes in before cruising to halftime with a 44-30 lead. Cengiz connected from distance to get Stony Brook with nine points with 7:08 remaining, but the Seawolves got no closer. Northwestern outshot Stony Brook from the floor 48%-39%, and the Wildcats were 12 for 23 from 3-point range (52%), while the Seawolves made 7 of 29 (24%). Up next Stony Brook: At Princeton on Wednesday. Northwestern: Hosts Boston University on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
